events.speaker: Alex
events.text: Good morning. This little room may look ordinary, but every story starts somewhere ordinary. Today, I found a tiny green plant by the window. It was leaning toward the sun, as if it already knew where it wanted to grow. I gave it a drink, opened the curtain, and made myself a promise. I would try one new thing before the day was over. Maybe it would be a drawing, a conversation, or a brave first step. The important part was beginning. By sunset, the room had not changed very much, but I had. And that was enough to make tomorrow feel exciting.
events.caption: Every story starts with one brave first step.
